BrochureContent.Content:
City Homes are Dublin 12’s local estate agents and it is with great delight that we present No. 71 Cherryfield Road, Walkinstown, Dublin 12 to the open market for sale.
This is a sizeable three-bedroom bay windowed mid-terrace residence ideally positioned on a mature and highly sought-after residential road. The property requires refurbishment works throughout but offers excellent potential for modernisation, allowing its new owners the opportunity to create a superb family home tailored to their own taste and specifications.
No. 71 benefits from a long rear garden with a perfect S/Westerly aspect and a large garage with laneway access — offering further development potential (subject to planning permission).
The bright and well-proportioned interior accommodation comprises a long welcoming hallway, a front lounge room, a second spacious reception room to the rear, and a kitchen with direct garden access. Upstairs there are three generous bedrooms (two double and one single) along with a bathroom with separate w/c.
Cherryfield Road is a quiet and settled residential location within a mature and ever-popular neighbourhood. Residents enjoy a wide range of nearby amenities including shopping centres, cafés, schools, and recreational facilities. The beautiful parklands of Beechfield Park are within a short walking distance while a selection of well-established primary and secondary schools are close at hand.
The area is very well serviced by public transport, offering easy access to Dublin City Centre, which is approximately 6km away. The M50 motorway is also within a short drive, providing excellent connectivity to all major routes.
